_comment: This is the file operators actually maintain — not the code. Every address below was pulled live from robinhoodchain.blockscout.com on 2026-09-08 and is a real, currently-deployed, verified contract. IMPORTANT: there is no single 'official' $HOOD token on Robinhood Chain — GreenHood, Hoodrat, Robin Hood (FOX), Good In The Hood (GOOD) and others all independently claim hood-themed branding. Listing a token here is NOT an endorsement or a claim that it is official; it means the token is an established, already-deployed contract, which is the baseline the impersonation lane flags NEW near-miss clones against. Add entries you've manually verified; don't auto-populate this from search results.

reference_tokens.name: GreenHood
reference_tokens.note: established HOOD-ticker token on RH Chain, not an official Robinhood asset
